results.notes: Counted Asn (AAU, AAC), His (CAU, CAC), Pro (CCU, CCC, CCA, CCG) codons from the 649 translated codons (excluding stop UAA). Manual tally gave 23 Asn, 24 His, 45 Pro.

Computed day-of-year for each date using 2002 calendar (Jan1 Tue). For each range, counted number of specific weekday or business days using formula: count = floor((D - offset + 6)/7) where offset = (target_dow - start_dow) mod 7. For business days, subtracted weekends from total days. All calculations double-checked.

For each sample, computed mass loss on heating, used stoichiometry to find mass of first-named compound, then its percentage. Atomic masses: H=1.008, C=12.011, O=15.999, Na=22.990, Cl=35.45, K=39.098, Ca=40.078, Zn=65.38. Results: 1) ZnCO3+NaCl: loss 4.30g CO2→ZnCO3 12.2515g=55.0%. 2) NaHCO3+NaCl: loss 4.24g H2O+CO2→NaHCO3 11.4853g=81.0%. 3) CaCO3+K2CO3: loss 3.73g CO2→CaCO3 8.4830g=33.0%. 4) Na2CO3·10H2O+NaHCO3: loss 8.36g, solving mass balance yields hydrate 5.630g=30.1%. 5) CaCO3+NaCl: loss 1.54g CO2→CaCO3 3.5025g=36.1%.
Simulated the stack machine through all 490 instructions step by step, maintaining the stack as a list. The final top element after instruction 490 (ADD) is -84.
Found discrete log by computing successive powers of 3 mod 701 until reaching 288 at exponent 547. Then computed K = 202^547 mod 701 = 147 via repeated squaring.

Sorted all 150 marginal costs. For a candidate n, price P = (5624 + sum of n smallest costs)/(n+1). Found n=85 satisfies: P=11920/86=5960/43 ≈ 138.60, which is > cost of 85th firm (120) and ≤ cost of 86th firm (141), so firms with cost < P are active, others produce zero.

Simulated month by month: starting balance $53947.92, monthly interest rounded to nearest cent, subtract $445 regular payment, then extra prepayments at months 3,8,10,39,57,70. Rate changes per schedule. After month 84, balance = $26960.19.
Sorted 79 words using custom alphabet order b<n<z<o<i<p<t<u<e<r<k<d. Grouped by first letter, then sorted lexicographically by successive letters using rank mapping.

Computed stepwise frequency using just intonation ratios for each interval (semitones derived from note names and octaves). Starting A4=440 Hz, multiplied/divided by ratios for each melodic interval, tracking fractions. Final fraction reduced.
